title: Presence claim
description: A derived claim that Christian presence of a given kind is attested at a place within a date range. Claims are generated from evidence items by pipeline/derive-claims.ts; hand-authored claims are rejected in CI. One file per claim under data/claims/, named <id>.json.

id.description: Stable slug. Must equal the filename without .json; checked by validate.ts.

claim_type.$comment: Values in schema/vocab/claim-type.json; membership is checked by validate.ts.

confidence.$comment: Computed by derive-claims.ts from evidence grades and independence; not set by hand. Left loosely typed until the derivation rules exist.

evidence.description: IDs of the evidence items this claim rests on. Every ID must exist under data/evidence/; checked by validate.ts.

rules_version.description: Version of the derivation rules that produced this claim, so any claim can be traced to the exact rule text.

rule.description: Identifier of the specific rule, e.g. 'council-subscription-implies-bishopric'.

year.$comment: ISO 8601 / astronomical year numbering: 1 BCE is 0, 2 BCE is -1.
